name: Monclan Yamato
description:
Sell later: Restorative Shot (when you buy Hunter's Aura), Stalker (when you buy Melee Charge), Mystic Shot (when you buy Extra Health), Close Quarters (when you buy Berserker), Healbane (when you buy Refresher).
Corrupt at the Broker, in order: Lifestrike, Spirit Snatch, Berserker, Radiant Regeneration, Crushing Fists, Refresher.

Generated from aggregate high-rank match stats: items and abilities are scored by usage rate and win rate, then assembled into a buy order.

Created with Claude's help via github.com/GidntSquia/deadlock-optimal-build-finder.
